name: example-beat
brief: Example beat: a two-person interview or podcast. A moment is clippable when it is emotionally or comedically self-contained and would make a strong 15-45s vertical clip on its own. Favor: candid chemistry or banter between the guests, relationship or backstory reveals, surprising or vulnerable admissions, genuinely funny one-liners, quotable statements about their work, and warm teasing. Avoid: interview logistics, long interviewer monologue, dead air or filler, off-topic tangents, and anything that only makes sense with lots of missing context.
positive_examples: A candid, laughing exchange where one guest teases the other about how they met.
A short, quotable line about working together that reveals something personal.
An unexpectedly vulnerable admission about the relationship that lands emotionally.
negative_examples: The interviewer explaining the format of the show for thirty seconds.
Scheduling or logistics talk with no emotional or comedic payoff.
A tangent that only makes sense if you saw a different part of the interview.
